title: The Bear Hunt
checked: Every reachable state checked (10 states, 10 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 9 states is reached from the start, and every path can still reach its end (surprise).

rules.rule: We meet the bear on tiptoe
rules.says: From the bear on (bear, blanket, picnic) we are never mid-stomp: a stomp in the cave is always followed by a quiet try.
rules.path: Take away the quiet guard and it breaks in 7 steps: march, through it, across it, over it, hold hands, stomp! [quiet], barge in stomping.

rules.rule: Nobody runs home before seeing the bear
rules.says: We only reach the blanket and the picnic once we have peeked at the bear.
rules.path: Take away the bear first guard and it breaks in 5 steps: march, through it, across it, over it, run home early.
